statement: ∀ (s : ℝ) (f : KdVPlan.Coeff), KdVPlan.MemH s f ↔ ∃ x : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2, f = KdVPlan.FromLP s x
proof:
intro s f
constructor
· intro hf
  have hx : Memℓp (fun k : ℤ => (KdVPlan.weight (s/2) k : ℂ) * f k) 2 := by
    apply memℓp_gen
    have he : (fun k : ℤ => ‖(KdVPlan.weight (s/2) k : ℂ)*f k‖ ^ (2 : ℝ≥0∞).toReal) =
        (fun k => KdVPlan.weight s k * ‖f k‖^2) := by
      funext k
      simpa using (yui_aux_0002 T gamma R s f k).1
    rw [he]
    exact hf
  refine ⟨⟨_, hx⟩, ?_⟩
  funext k
  exact ((yui_aux_0002 T gamma R s f k).2.2).symm
· rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩
  exact (yui_aux_0003 T gamma R s x).1
